name: Nextcloud
description: Self-hosted content collaboration and file sync platform.
summary: AI-assisted code is allowed with disclosure in the PR and an Assisted-by trailer on each commit; you must be able to explain every line and check licensing. No autonomous agents. Issues, PR descriptions and review comments must be in your own words; translation and grammar help are fine.

evidence.quote: Every pull request containing AI-assisted code, documentation, or tests must declare this in the PR description.
The contributor is the legal and moral author of every line they submit.
AI agents must not open issues, submit pull requests, post review comments, or send security reports autonomously.
Contributors must ensure AI-generated code contains no material from sources incompatible with the license of the repository or app they are contributing to.
AI-generated security reports must be independently verified before submission; unverified reports might be closed without response.
Issues, PR descriptions, and review comments must be in the contributor's own words. Translation assistance and grammar/spelling help are acceptable exceptions and do not need to be disclosed
